jamie (eng-platform): seeing a few customer requests show up in the gateway access logs but no corresponding decision_log entry. request-id=rc-9f2a, trace_id=trc-01aa. anyone seen this pattern?

sasha (eng-sre): hmm. any header normalization happening in the gateway? sometimes tenant header case/aliases get normalized after sampling so trace drops.

jamie (eng-platform): gateway normalizes X-Tenant-ID -> x-tenant-id earlier in the pipeline. the access log shows x-tenant-id present on the request.

matt (eng-runtime): can you paste a raw request snippet and the router decision output if available?

jamie (eng-platform): raw headers (redacted):
```
GET /v1/infer
Host: api.redwood.example
x-tenant-id: acme
x-correlation-id: trc-01aa
User-Agent: curl/7.85.0
```
no decision_log entry for trace trc-01aa in the dst-decision store when I query it.

sasha (eng-sre): what's the sampling config for that tenant? low-volume tenants get 0.5% by default. if the sampling decision happens before header rewrite we can end up attributing to the wrong key and drop it.

jamie (eng-platform): tenant is on default sampling. but this specific request had an override header x-sampler-force=1 (added by a proxy) — odd.

matt (eng-runtime): aha. order matters: prefilter sampling -> header normalization -> rule eval. if x-sampler-force is attached after prefilter, decision log could be recorded under a different fingerprint and not correlated to the request trace.

jamie (eng-platform): how do we surface that in console? customer is asking for trace-level evidence.

irene (eng-platform): there's a tracing toggle in the Routing -> Decision Logs UI to 'show prefilter and postfilter traces'. but it only works if the trace was sampled. we should be able to query raw route-traces via the debug API.

sasha (eng-sre): quick debug query (internal):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEBUG" "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/route-traces?trace_id=trc-01aa&expand=all" | jq '.events[] | {ts,stage,meta}'
```
that will show prefilter sampling decision, header rewrite, and final match. run it from bastion.

jamie (eng-platform): ran it — output shows prefilter: sampled=false at 12:03:21, later header_rewrite event at 12:03:21. final match exists but no recorded decision_log_write event.

matt (eng-runtime): that sequence explains it. prefilter sampled=false -> we bypass decision log writer. header_rewrite then toggles a force flag but it's too late.

irene (eng-platform): short-term fix: adjust prefilter to consider x-sampler-force before sampling. that'll allow immediate forced-samples to be honored. long-term: make sampling and header-normalizer order deterministic (normalize headers earlier).

jamie (eng-platform): can we do a hotfix? change is small but touches hot path.

sasha (eng-sre): can deploy a feature-flagged change: feature/normalize-before-sample on staging, run smoke for 30m, then roll to prod behind FF. I can handle rollout.

matt (eng-runtime): PR ready. includes unit + a small perf bench (no measurable regression).

deployer-bot: started deployment of feature/normalize-before-sample to staging (build 2026.3.14-ff12).

jamie (eng-platform): once staging looks good, let's enable the console trace toggle to surface prefilter events by default for 100% of admin requests so support can fetch missing decision logs easily.

irene (eng-platform): assigning follow-up: irene -> update docs on routing debug steps, jamie -> notify support template, sasha -> rollout plan.

jamie (eng-platform): thanks. recording action items in the runbook and will ping infra channel when FF is enabled. :thumbsup:
